description: On CI the unit suite's time is the time of its git processes. A git spawn costs about 25 ms on macos-latest and about 5 ms on ubuntu-latest; the unit selection starts 45,157 git processes (counted per test with a PATH shim), which accounts for about 1,195 s of the 1,424 s summed macOS test time. Workers finish within 4 s of each other, so the macOS job's wall time is the summed time divided by its 3 workers. The twelve files in scope run whole stage pipelines against real repositories; on main at 412bed21 they take 299.6 s summed on macOS and 47.2 s on ubuntu over 223 cases and start 12,184 git processes, 89 percent of them inside the test call (rev-parse 19 percent, 'git -c' 17 percent, ls-remote 11 percent, fetch 5 percent), not in fixture setup, which already copies read-only template repositories. Per-test coverage shows identical line sets for several groups of cases: test_sync_boundaries.py's nine boundary-by-stage cases fall into two identical groups (six STAGE_START and STAGE_END cases, three FLOW_START cases); in test_dispatch.py the [malformed] pass-rate case matches test_pipeline_dispatches_intent_plan_execute_with_resolved_runner; in test_plan_decision.py the [top-level] and [at-the-depth-limit] cases match.
goal: Cut the git processes and summed time of the files in scope by at least 40 percent without weakening what they prove. In order: (1) where several tests run the same pipeline scenario and only assert different facts about its result, run the scenario once (a module-scoped fixture over a private copy, or one test with all the assertions) and keep each assertion; (2) collapse parametrised cases whose per-test line coverage is identical and whose parameter only changes data the code does not branch on, keeping one case per distinct code path and folding any case-specific assertion into it; (3) reach a stage's start state by copying a prepared template repository instead of running the earlier stages through production code, where the test does not assert on those earlier stages; (4) keep the sleep-free, network-free and template read-only rules. Test code only. Module line budgets (holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json) are frozen: that file is never changed; a module this change touches stays within its limit, and new helper code goes into new modules rather than growing an existing one past its limit.
rationale: These files are the largest share of the macOS unit job, which sets the length of every pipeline wait. Expected saving at 45 percent: about 45 s off the macOS unit job, about 11 s off the ubuntu unit job and about 11 s off the workspace-survival job per pipeline run.
acceptance_criteria: The execution notes carry a before and after table per file in scope (summed test time, case count, and the number of git processes started, counted per test with a PATH shim that logs PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST), from 'uv run pytest -n auto --dist worksteal -m "not integration_test and not stress" --durations=0 --junitxml=<report>' on the same machine, median of at least three alternating runs; the summed time and the git process count of the files in scope are each at least 40 percent lower.

Every removed or merged test is listed with the surviving test that proves the same behaviour and the evidence (identical or subset line coverage from a per-test coverage context run, plus the assertion it carried now made by the surviving test). No test that guards a distinct behaviour is removed: a test named for a regression, an incident or an edge case is kept or its assertion is folded into a surviving test, never dropped.
Line and branch coverage of the production modules the files in scope exercise, measured before and after with 'uv run pytest --cov', do not fall.
No file under apps/sandbox-executor/src is changed.
Module line budgets: holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json is unchanged and no touched module exceeds its limit.

The whole unit selection passes with 'uv run pytest -n auto --dist worksteal -m "not integration_test and not stress"', the files in scope also pass serially with '-p no:xdist' (no order dependence from shared fixtures), and 'uv run task lint' and 'uv run task lint-docs' pass.
